name: Internet Token LiquidityUnifier unvalidated V3 pool callback mint
summary: LiquidityUnifier.swapV3(token, pool) is permissionless and accepts any contract whose token0()/token1() return the reward token and the caller-chosen token; it never checks a Uniswap factory or registry. It stores the caller-supplied pool in currentPoolV3 and calls its swap(), and uniswapV3SwapCallback then mints INT to currentPoolV3 in an amount the caller controls, guarded only by msg.sender == currentPoolV3. The validateSupply modifier is defeated inside the same call by burning the minted INT through the Convertor and re-minting it after swapV3 returns. Any caller can therefore mint unbacked INT through the TOKEN_MINTER role the unifier holds and sell it into protocol-owned liquidity, breaking the invariant that INT is minted only against a genuine pool swap of the configured swapAmount.

loss.notes: Component 1 is the first exercise's depletion of the protocol-owned INT/WETH Uniswap V3 pool 0xdec6eadbd8ed3f655cba4bb4eeff6fb43b16969d. Components 2 and 3 are five later copycat transactions by other actors repeating the same swapV3 fake-pool mint before the TOKEN_MINTER role was revoked; they took WETH from the same pool and USDC from two Uniswap V4 USDC/INT pools. Unbacked INT kept by attackers (764,145,702.183763063166443405 INT by the first attacker, later burned) is dilution, not measured victim depletion. Copycat WETH is valued at the first-exercise quote; all merged transactions fall within 2,744 seconds.

ageReset.description: The IntV3Initializer 0xc1494cb284c8d794497468c560ae301864e5bd26, executed by Safe 0x0c02d2d320c62d4088840a459fe8862c802fba78, granted LiquidityUnifier the TOKEN_MINTER role in RoleStore 0xd5d1a16084a116f8a6c2c706c110dbad2e99be83 (roleCache[unifier][TOKEN_MINTER] 0 -> 1). Without it the callback's RewardToken.mint reverts, so the role is necessary to the exploited condition; the unifier was deployed 23,272 blocks earlier without it and no later grant, revoke or unifier configuration call preceded the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and first exercise. Source-1 (Base block 51593878 index 101) is a contract creation by EOA 0x5f7ce6395818857ac20730dc990f614356d1ec68 creating 0x4acac3ecb4912147cbbf9dc927368a046e35b5b6, whose constructor creates fake pool 0x94d9b828a9fa0d7d788127c827c8c0a268a35f69. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): the fake pool calls LiquidityUnifier 0x837dbabc4f5fa78baf177597edbda09645822032 swapV3 (0xd28e8f03) with token = INT 0x968d6a288d7b024d5012c0b25d67a889e4e3ec19 and pool = itself; the unifier calls the fake pool's swap, which re-enters uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33) with delta 925411678379023085745037207; the unifier calls INT.mint (0x40c10f19) to the fake pool. Receipt Transfer logs 294-301: mint 925411678.379023085745037207 INT to the fake pool, burn of the same amount and release of the same amount of OptimismMintableERC20 0x1d34e08120dbd1ea9bdbcd90c2dc919b50ddff4c by Convertor 0x6b82fdfc0344bd76d5cb58bc24d0ffe947975516 (restoring totalSupply before validateSupply's post-check), then after swapV3 returns the OTHER token goes back to the Convertor and the same INT amount is re-minted (log 301). Logs 302/304: 161265976.195260022578593802 INT paid into INT/WETH pool 0xdec6eadbd8ed3f655cba4bb4eeff6fb43b16969d for 5.846988019325688317 WETH; log 306 sends 764145702.183763063166443405 INT and log 307 the WETH to the EOA. Verified LiquidityUnifier source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=8453; v0.8.34+commit.80d5c536, optimizer 200 runs; SHA-256 of SourceCode 12e18e2e643fec9aeea469400f01bea1e9de9e66e3eb1d7171267fa9b5aadcd5): swapV3 has no role modifier; _validatePool checks only nonzero address, code length and _excludedPools (which holds only the real pool); _validatePoolV3Tokens compares token0()/token1() with {rewardToken, token}; uniswapV3SwapCallback checks only msg.sender == currentPoolV3 and mints the supplied positive delta. RewardToken source (SHA-256 bfce00d63f46d03f58f91825d93c987567d00959aece0348d058ec470a167d89) gates mint with onlyRole(TOKEN_MINTER) through RoleStore 0xd5d1a16084a116f8a6c2c706c110dbad2e99be83. Earliest exercise: eth_getLogs INT Transfer(topic1 = zero address) over blocks 45045747..51593878 in 200000-block chunks returns 3 logs in two transactions, the 23,600,000 INT initializer mint in source-4 and source-1; no swapV2 or swapV3 mint by the unifier precedes source-1. The Convertor (created block 12149087, 2024) behaves as designed; it only supplies the supply-neutral round trip and is not a separate target.

Reviewed complete gross loss. WETH.balanceOf(pool 0xdec6eadbd8ed3f655cba4bb4eeff6fb43b16969d) is 5847033390701967596 at block 51593877 and 45371376279279 at block 51593878; source-1 log 302 transfers 5846988019325688317 wei out. The pool is the protocol-owned INT/WETH V3 position (token0 WETH, token1 INT) and the only address in LiquidityUnifier.excludedPools. Merged copycats: eth_getLogs INT mints over blocks 51593878..51923974 yields 16 transactions through 0x075439c2390572b6a526e019f4c000da317a8ff067e446c22f5593be076f8be2 (block 51596204); callTracer shows each of the five with non-INT outflows calling swapV3 (0xd28e8f03) and the callback mint from a fresh fake pool. Receipt Transfer logs: source-9 (block 51593899:81) 3712433917999873, source-10 (51593967:89) 1421028680038599, source-11 (51593989:96) 4820048370009714 and source-13 (51595250:52) 1027687360577 wei WETH from pool 0xdec6eadb, total 9954538655408763 wei; USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 from Uniswap V4 PoolManager 0x498581ff718922c3f8e6a244956af099b2652b2b in source-12 (51595134:58) 2424475 and source-13 28597052 + 2834143 units (6 decimals), total 33855670. The only PoolManager Swap events in those receipts are pool ids 0x20b126ee729d1f10a56e1c938c93855477604548e84d0542a025fa3355bae62d and 0x70d13ff7ed37e0e18b3e66a6f9800a43905ce47dfad3d63dd9d0648abc751616, whose Initialize events name currency0 USDC and currency1 INT. The other 11 mint transactions have no non-INT outflow. RoleStore.hasRole(unifier, TOKEN_MINTER) is true at block 51604090 and false at 51604091 (timestamp 1789997529), ending the fault window. The first attacker's remaining 764145702.183763063166443405 INT go to the zero address in 0x0f6615e7fe13ecd38339a131300c05788e07465b5ad2a2bf5ba271854c064262 (block 51604425) and are not counted. WETH is valued with the DefiLlama base:WETH quote at the anchor (source-8); USDC at par.

Reviewed artifact identity and age history. LiquidityUnifier 0x837dbabc4f5fa78baf177597edbda09645822032 is a direct, non-proxy runtime created top-level by 0x58b680c580fd68cd896d8466768c4e85011a7f5c in source-3 (block 45045747 index 64, timestamp 1776880841); eth_getCode is empty at block 45045746 and keccak256 of the runtime is 0x0a354aa58b3eb1ea65f098c481035da072b71395c47bf3f956a8d24b8b451bf3 at blocks 45045747 and 51593877. rewardToken is immutable (INT); constructor arguments (roleStore 0xd5d1a16084a116f8a6c2c706c110dbad2e99be83, INT, treasury 0xe05dd5b785f578337b2b8f695fbc521669c69403, swapAmount 1e27, keeperFee 1e8) do not bear on the defect. Causal configuration: RoleStore.hasRole(address,bytes32)(unifier, keccak256(abi.encode("TOKEN_MINTER")) = 0xb77a48db4266813e82e1cdfbc47bca32aab994909c42cb5090bb0dd63e40bc1f) is false at block 45069015 and true at 45069016; binary search over eth_call fixes that block. roleCache is mapping slot 3, so the flag is storage slot keccak256(role . keccak256(pad(unifier) . pad(3))) = 0x9c9f4d035f1af5dfb4041dcb0d421c11d420d75ac503b5ca991eb586a4ed512f: eth_getStorageAt 0 at block 45069015, 1 at 45069016 and 51593877. debug_traceBlockByNumber(45069016, callTracer): the only RoleStore writes are in source-4 (index 29), Safe 0x0c02d2d320c62d4088840a459fe8862c802fba78 execTransaction -> IntV3Initializer 0xc1494cb284c8d794497468c560ae301864e5bd26, which calls grantRole(address,bytes32) (0xab2742dc) for the unifier with TOKEN_MINTER and TOKEN_BURNER, calls the unifier once (0xce4e5a59), and revokes its own temporary roles. Continuity: ROLE_ADMIN members are [0xe05dd5b785f578337b2b8f695fbc521669c69403 (GovTimelockController), Safe 0x0c02...] at blocks 45069015 and 51593877. Etherscan txlist for the Safe over 45069016..51593878 returns 11 execTransaction calls; callTracer on each finds no grantRole/revokeRole (0x208dd1ff) naming the unifier, no ROLE_ADMIN grant and no non-static call to the unifier except source-4. The timelock has no direct transactions in that window and its three CallExecuted transactions (0xe32171f919f3331a568e1a2a2163efbe7dbb278e60d19dccb626204248961c26, 0x090a5e06bbe11206e613464a5b7c51945e6b3cc390eb1d2134102b04e823782e, 0x640c8fd8615edab0457bc0a01df4254af60395918bf25a29ab3c2eddf1245cf1) target neither RoleStore nor the unifier. The grant is the latest pre-exploit change establishing the vulnerable code-and-state combination; code age 1789977103 - 1776927379 = 13049724 seconds.
